scope: Current main-board uncertainties after the 522d235 architect review and user D3 follow-up. J1 numbering corrected from photos, R41 named neutrally; D3 rail assignment resolved by user measurement with closure history retained. D2 local destinations now have user evidence: R to C20 lower end, L to ANT2/R46 upper, S to R46 lower; R46 is DNP. Exact part identity remains open. U3.5 VREF and J3.3 ground now measured; disproven R23 and J3 role guesses withdrawn in v0.9.13.

rails.name: BATTERY+
rails.path: Battery positive -> Q1 single pad/native3 (candidate drain); TP14/R43.2 on the raw side.
rails.basis: User battery-path report; TP14 raw-side placement from photo plus V015-TP14/R43.2 confirmation.

rails.name: VSYS
rails.board_label: No printed net name; user-approved name
rails.path: Q1.L/native2 -> U5/MX512H pin4; L1.1 and L2.1 supply sides.
rails.basis: User-confirmed shared supply; filter terminal numbering is photo-derived. Do not join their opposite ends.

rails.name: VDD
rails.path: TP103, PIC20/C32, U5 pin1/VCC, V064/V063/V075/V082. D3.R via V082 is user-confirmed.
rails.basis: User via/test-point continuity. Distinct from VSYS and BATTERY+.

rails.name: VREF
rails.path: TP104, PIC21/RB0/V026, PIC4/RA2/V035/C39, R21.2/V071. U3.5 and R22 D/left/model2 at 1 ohm.
rails.basis: User-confirmed core plus U3.5/R22 D/left. R48 remains inferred; R23 branch rejected.

rails.name: GND
rails.basis: User ground reports and matched rear copper; association of every candidate branch is not thereby proved.

confirmed_summary: 150 catalog entries on one A2 sheet, with 20 stock and 4 authorized custom symbol definitions in use.
All PIC pads have modeled local nets; user-confirmed tuning controls and H-bridge INA/INB routes are retained.
BATTERY+, VSYS, VDD, VREF and GND are distinguished; L1/L2 supply sides both connect to VSYS.
Reported continuity, resistance and negative results are preserved separately from inferred connections.
Original ZIP and 26 original photo hashes are preserved; native/model net partitions match.
User U3.5-VREF and R22 D/left at 1 ohm; R22 E/right 10 kohm away. J3.3-GND 1 ohm; J3.2-GND 290 kohm. R23-VREF and old J3 role hypotheses withdrawn.

issues.known: Marking 4P. Diode readings support R -> S -> L series-junction behavior in circuit. Photo R=upper-left, L=upper-right, S=single lower. User confirms R-C20 lower 1 ohm; L-ANT2/R46 upper; S-R46 lower. R46 unpopulated. S-ANT2 OL; S-GND 700 kohm, S-VREF 1.32 Mohm. Outer pads show high resistance to VDD/GND.
issues.unknown: All three D2 local destinations are resolved. Exact part, ratings and physical package numbering remain unknown; internal series topology is probable from in-circuit tests. Other RX_A_PLUS branches remain inferred. The purpose/value of the empty R46 option is unknown; no resistor is fitted.
issues.next_action: No further D2 rail or local continuity sweep is needed. Seek a manufacturer 4P marking/package match consistent with the series-junction measurements; retain the explicit equivalent-circuit assumption if identity cannot be recovered. Do not fit or bridge R46.
issues.closed_when: A compatible device pin map and all three external endpoints are supported by evidence.

issues.known: A7 supports a BAV99 candidate. User continuity joins V082 to the board VDD test point.
issues.unknown: Which physical D3 terminal reaches V082. Current D3.L=GND, D3.R=H_RX_VDD and D3.S=H_RX_RF_SENSE are provisional; none is presently assigned to VDD.
issues.next_action: Measure V082 to each of D3's three pads. Record low-ohm continuity separately from diode/resistive readings.
issues.closed_when: The actual pad is identified and conflicting modeled branches are corrected, without blindly merging VDD and the receiver supply.

resolution.result: User identifies D3.L=GND and D3.R=VDD through V082. Move only D3.R off the hypothetical receiver supply. D3.S-to-R42 measures 1.2 ohm (resistor end not stated; photo selects pad2). Signal function remains with E06 and candidate identity with I01.

issues.known: Q8 centre B2/native5 is GND via V113/V115. V114 is U2.T2/native2 GND. Outer Q8 pads are joined by the earlier low-resistance result. Candidate Q8 P-source/native2 is on filtered VSYS; P-gate/native3 is driven by U2 output4 through R8, while U2 uses VDD.
issues.unknown: C6.1 route and Q8 source-supply path. F-P=10 ohm supports a supply-related path but does not establish a direct copper join. Exact Q8 maker remains a candidate. Gate-drive headroom is unverified: a hypothetical source=6V and gate-high=4.5V gives VGS=-1.5V, not guaranteed off for the candidate threshold range. These are illustrative, not measured voltages.
issues.next_action: Start with C6's non-ground pad and the L1 output/Q8 supply node; record resistance both ways. Use the existing labelled Q8 photo, not the withdrawn C6-to-output wire. After passive routing, measure VDD plus Q8 source and gate high/low during scanning, all relative to PCB GND; compute VGS. Waveforms require a scope if available. Never place an earth-referenced scope ground on a driven antenna/motor node.
issues.closed_when: C6 and Q8 supply routes are resolved, including any intervening component.

issues.known: All five PIC control inputs are mapped. Seven capacitor-midpoint comparisons gave OL. User now confirms ANT2 directly to D2.L.
issues.unknown: The model uses PNPs with emitter/native2 at GND and base driven through a resistor by nonnegative GPIO. This is not ordinary forward-operated PNP switching. Ground association, pad orientation/type or an RF junction-switching role may be wrong/incomplete. Capacitor-midpoint antenna continuations remain unresolved. ANT2-D2.L is now verified; further tuning/antenna connections remain open.
issues.next_action: Finish ONE cell, Q3/C10/C11/C12: map Q3 physical paired/single pads, both terminals of all three capacitors on both sides and the antenna continuation. Start from IMG_2433/IMG_2442 and V107. Compare Q3.L to the established GND point, Q3.R to R13.2, Q3.S to C10.1, and V107 to the relevant C10/C11/C12 junction. Confirm candidate pairs, do not infer them as measured. Use diode tests to constrain transistor type; base identification alone need not distinguish emitter/collector. Then use symmetry for the others. Preserve all seven OL exclusions.
issues.closed_when: One cell has an evidence-supported functional topology and antenna connection, then the other four have targeted corroboration; no PNP-to-NPN change based solely on plausibility.

issues.known: R41=331 gives 330 ohm. In the current model H_BUTTON reaches PIC28/ICSP_DAT THROUGH R40, not by a direct copper net. S1 common leg pairs remain a normal-switch hypothesis.
issues.unknown: R41.1/H_R41_FREE has an unknown destination; its former H_BUTTON_MCU name was not evidence of another MCU connection. A supply, bias or other control destination is possible.
issues.next_action: Inspect the short R41 trace in IMG_2438 first. Identify the physical pad that does not reach the S1/R40 button side, then check only candidate nearby VDD, VSYS or TP4/R44 control nodes chosen from the photo. A nonzero resistance is not direct continuity. Confirm S1 common pairs released/pressed. Do not scan all PIC pins or assume a pull-up.
issues.closed_when: Switch pairings and the button signal destination are verified.

issues.known: Every PIC pad has a modeled local net. PIC2 reaches C25/V031; PIC14 reaches TP11; PIC18 reaches TP17. D3.S-to-R42 measured 1.2 ohm; exact resistor end not named, pad2 selected from photo. R42.1 already reaches TP4/PIC25/RB4.
issues.unknown: Onward roles of those three nodes, D1.R/H_D1_FREE, C26.1 and TP9.1. Local connectivity is not proof that these are intentionally unused. H_RF_CONTROL has only R6.2/R7.1: its excitation source is absent. H_BAT_SENSE has a series path through R4 to PIC24/RB3, so the missing item is functional interpretation/route confidence, not necessarily another MCU endpoint. H_D3_SIGNAL replaces the misleading H_RX_RF_SENSE name; operating role remains unknown.
issues.next_action: Use existing photo/via evidence to select specific endpoints for the local-only PIC nodes, D1.R and H_RF_CONTROL. Review R3-R4-C28 together with PIC24: document a compatible sensing mechanism, without adding an extra sampling wire solely from a net-name assumption.
issues.closed_when: Each branch has an endpoint or supported evidence that it terminates intentionally.

issues.known: C2NM supports an S-812C33AMC candidate. V067 reaches J3.1/red and the U6A option pad; V063 reaches regulated VDD. U6 ground is supported by the user readings. User measures J3.3-GND 1 ohm and J3.2-GND 290 kohm; pin3 is ground, pin2 is separate.
issues.unknown: J3.2 onward signal route, U6 VIN/VOUT external branches, NC-pad external ties, actual PIR voltage and Q2 interface. H_PIR_SIG ends at Q2.S/TP16 with no modeled controller destination.
issues.next_action: Measure J3.2 to both R38 ends in the finishing photo guide to test the signal-interface candidate. Do not repeat connector ground checks. Then trace Q2/TP16 toward a specific controller endpoint and check U6 external branches.
issues.closed_when: Physical connector ordering, U6 supply/output and signal path are verified; NC pads are documented whether tied externally or left unused.

issues.known: PIC12/RC1 reaches R18 via V053-V070. V064-V075 is continuity; V064-V070=11.2 kohm supports the R18+R19 path. VREF reaches R21.2, PIC21 and PIC4. TP6/C18.2 is separate from U3.5/C18.1. User U3.5-VREF 1 ohm and U3.5-R22 D/left 1 ohm establish the input DC return; R22 E/right is 10 kohm away. Both R23 ends are 270-289 kohm to U3.5.
issues.unknown: R23.2 destination after its VREF tie was rejected, R23 physical-end numbering and remaining feedback/coupling branches, R22 E/right ground and R48.2 VREF hypotheses. Q7 terminal selection/power-switch role remains inferred. TP6 onward role and H_RX_DETECT downstream destination remain unresolved.
issues.next_action: Measure U3.6 to both R23 ends, then R22 E/right to GND as shown in the finishing guide. These test the remaining feedback association and the opposite bias resistor end. Preserve separation across C18. Trace C23/C40/R25 output next; do not repeat U3.5-VREF tests or invent a bias resistor.
issues.closed_when: Receiver supply, bias, gain/filter paths and interface endpoints are reconciled against evidence. U3.5 has a documented DC return or supported intentional nonstandard mechanism, and the detector output has a supported functional destination.

resolved_subquestions.result: U3.5 DC return established by direct VREF connection.

issues.known: BATTERY+ and VSYS are separate. User confirms Q1.L to U5.4 and both L1/L2 supply sides on VSYS. VDD TP is the separate logic rail. R1A matches FMOS3401A marking.
issues.unknown: Exact Q1 maker and gate operation, unmeasured rail voltages, and U1 enable/option branches. Reverse-polarity protection is an interpretation, not a powered test.
issues.next_action: Cross-check Q1 gate/R44 and U1 enable wiring first. After routing reconciliation, use one powered session on the original hardware/supplies: BATTERY+, VSYS, VDD, VREF, U6 output, Q8 source/gates and both U5 control inputs, idle and during a triggered scan. Receiver power may be switched. No battery/PIC/RF redesign.
issues.closed_when: Gate/control behavior and actual supply levels are established without shorting across Q1, L1 or L2.

issues.known: D4/D5=5U supports SD05 TVS candidates. D6=G3 has at least two documented Zener candidates. ICSP signal routes are photo-derived. J1 square-pad/VPP end is resolved from IMG_2437 and corroborated by IMG_2439: 1 VPP, 2 VDD, 3 GND, 4 DAT, 5 CLK. Electrical signal destinations are unchanged.
issues.unknown: Both D6 pad routes, exact voltage/polarity and candidate diode identities remain open. J1 pitch and lead geometry remain photo-based; its sequential numbering is now resolved.
issues.next_action: Measure D6 pads to adjacent PIC/ICSP nodes using the corrected J1 numbering. Do not repeat J1 position identification; position evidence is photographic, not new meter confirmation.
issues.closed_when: D6 connections and candidate class are supported; ICSP connector physical numbering is reconciled. Zener voltage needs a suitable controlled test or exact part evidence, not ordinary diode mode.

resolved_subtasks.result: IMG_2437 front: CLK-DAT-GND-VDD-VPP left to right; square pad is VPP/right end. IMG_2439 rear corroborates square end. Native pin1=VPP,2=VDD,3=GND,4=DAT,5=CLK; photo-based physical order, not new electrical measurements.

issues.known: Primary datasheets and marking evidence are recorded; custom symbols use the selected candidate pin tables. D3 measured rail connections fit the BAV99 clamp candidate; its identity is not newly proven.
issues.unknown: Short markings do not uniquely prove manufacturers. Candidate choices and some B/E/C or MOSFET source/drain assignments remain qualified. Western alternatives are redesign options, not identities of fitted parts.
issues.next_action: Use electrical pad behavior and package/marking evidence for specific candidates. Do not request sharper photos where the existing marking is already legible.
issues.closed_when: Identity is either supported sufficiently for the reconstruction or explicitly retained as a functionally verified candidate with its limits documented.

issues.known: V127 reaches the photo-selected LED common pair; the two PIC LED drives are mapped. MX512H OUTA/OUTB map to the modeled motor connector.
issues.unknown: LED internal polarity/colour mapping and J5 physical A/B lead polarity remain provisional.
issues.next_action: Check LED pad pairs in diode mode and record emitted colour. Match J5 wire positions to U5 outputs by continuity.
issues.closed_when: LED internal mapping and connector orientation are established.

issues.known: C5 is 470 uF / 16 V; 38 fitted resistors have nominal marked values. R8 full-body dimensions support 0603 and C11 dimensions support 1206.
issues.unknown: Unmeasured fitted ceramic values and L1/L2 type/value remain listed by the component audit. Voltage rating, dielectric, resistor tolerance and power rating are separate evidence gaps.
issues.next_action: After one tuning cell topology is verified, prioritize its effective capacitance, RF shaping and receiver filters before bypass values. C11/C12 presently share both modeled nodes: an in-circuit reading is their effective network value, not individual values. Record frequency, mode, amplitude and in-circuit/isolated condition. Separate individual values only when needed for the BOM; do not assign an invented split or blanket 100nF.
issues.closed_when: Values needed for faithful circuit behavior are recovered; any remaining bypass substitutions or ratings are explicitly documented assumptions.

issues.known: Most entries have candidate stock footprints; R8 and C11 have user dimensions. J1 sequential numbering is corrected, but exact land-pattern dimensions remain photo-based.
issues.unknown: C5, S1 and LED1 footprints are blank. Other families, connector pitch, test-pad drills, switch lead span and exact board geometry are partly photo-based.
issues.next_action: Defer C5/S1/LED1 dimensions until the main signal paths are coherent; then measure can/lead spacing, switch body/lead span and LED pad pitch. Assigned families are not verified land patterns.
issues.closed_when: Blank footprints are filled with supported stock matches or approved vendor parts; exact PCB-reproduction dimensions are distinguished from schematic-only candidates.

issues.known: 16 open pads belong to unpopulated options. R46 is now fully mapped: upper to D2.L/ANT2, lower to D2.S, with no resistor fitted.
issues.unknown: Optional-pad routing is incomplete; values and intended uses may remain unknowable without another board variant.
issues.next_action: Record option copper where visible; defer measurement unless it affects a populated net.
issues.closed_when: Optional routes are documented to the desired reproduction scope; do not invent fitted values or no-connect flags.

issues.known: The one-sheet schematic has a native/model connectivity check and retained photo/via evidence; see the current validation counts.
issues.unknown: No powered functional validation, actual layer stack or routed KiCad PCB has been created. The PIR daughterboard internal circuit is not reconstructed. MCU firmware behavior and operating timing are not established.
issues.next_action: Finish priority electrical gaps first. Then test defined functions/voltages and decide whether physical PCB reproduction and daughterboard reverse engineering are needed.
issues.closed_when: Schematic assumptions are tested to an agreed scope; PCB and daughterboard work, if requested, receive their own explicit completion criteria.

milestones.name: Topology complete
milestones.criterion: Populated components and functional block interfaces have supported connections; candidate functions/polarities are compatible and remaining exceptions individually documented.

milestones.name: Value/package complete
milestones.criterion: Required values and geometry recovered; exact manufacturer/ratings separated from equivalent design choices. Routed PCB remains a separate deliverable.
